title: Set the annual budget
summary: Build next year's operating and capital budget for each property and get it approved.
outlineSteps: Pull the prior years' operating statements and confirm they foot
Remove depreciation, interest and one-time items
Ask the manager what was one-time and what was deferred
Project rent from the rent roll with its steps and expirations
Forecast vacancy, downtime and leasing costs for expiring leases
Set each expense line by average, trend or a current quote
Re-estimate property taxes at the current value
Set the management fee and the reimbursement budget
Set capital spending and reserves from the component schedule
Test the budget against comparable properties and the loan's coverage
Send the approved budget to the manager and, where required, the lender
